name: Higuchi Yumi
source:
A 2nd-year high school student who transferred into St. Claus Academy due to her parents' job relocation. Yumi is a normal, cheerful girl who can get along with anybody.

[Translation of her [URL=http://www.zutto-otome.jp/memories/memories_chara/cha_girls.html]official website profile[/URL].]
